title: ElevenLabs’ new app combines meeting note-taking and dictation for teams
lede: ElevenLabs released ElevenAI, an early-access app for teams that combines meeting notes, dictation and hooks into its own agent platform.

points: Takes meeting notes, tells participants they are being recorded, and answers questions across past meetings.
Gives live help during a call to recall details from earlier conversations.
Dictation turns speech into cleaned-up text in any app, in over 90 languages.
ElevenAgent can take follow-up actions, such as drafting an email from the notes.
It arrived alongside Scribe v3 speech-to-text models with live transcription and fine-tuning on company data.

sections.text: Scribe v3 lets companies fine-tune transcription on their own data, and ElevenAI shows the company packaging its models and agents as a team product rather than only an API.
